beans.name: Sermon
beans.description: Fruit-forward and full-bodied, Sermon is playful and approachable brewed or as espresso. This easy-drinking blend is built from thoughtfully chosen naturally-processed coffees from East Africa that contribute deep sweetness and berry notes and a washed Colombian component that provides structure and balance. Behold, your perfect morning.

recipes.title: Verve Sermon Dwell
recipes.description: Verve's Dwell Dripper suggestion for Sermon: 20 g to 300 g at 1:15 on a medium grind, drawn down at 2:21.

recipes.title: Verve Sermon French Press
recipes.description: Verve's French press suggestion for Sermon: 35 g to 500 g on a coarse grind, five minutes.
